issues.what: The bud sits lower and farther left, and reads as a side-on folded fan with an exposed mass of long parallel folds. The target has an upright rounded head, a taller spiked crown and a compact cluster of amber petals opening on the left.
issues.fix: Raise and shift the bud right, turn it more toward camera, restore the round sepal envelope and taller crown, and concentrate the amber translucency in the left petals rather than patchy yellow bands across the folds.

issues.where: 45.0 s, low sun and immediate surround (set-A-03.png, region 5)
issues.what: The long, thin starburst spikes and lemon-yellow core replace the target's broad soft peach-white bloom and diffuse amber shafts under the leaf.
issues.fix: Reproduce the soft broad bloom, lose the hard diagonal flare spikes, and extend warmer hazy spill into the low clouds and field.

issues.where: 50.5 s, low sun and immediate surround (set-A-06.png, region 5)
issues.what: The light pinches to a small hard star at the edge of the leaf, with a diagonal flare line and much less broad orange haze below it.
issues.fix: Open up the bright gap beneath the leaf and replace the hard rays with a broad soft white core and diffuse orange spill down over the field.

issues.where: 45.0 s, near neighbor at the left border (set-A-02.png, region 4, and upper-left frame)
issues.what: Large soft dark leaves form a vertical obstruction to the left of the sun instead of the target's pointed upper leaf reaching over the sun and a layered sweep of smaller lower leaves.
issues.fix: Reframe and reshape the near neighbor to reach diagonally over the sun, recover the separate lower leaves and warm edge glints, and keep openings between its silhouettes.

issues.where: 50.5 s, near neighbor at the left border (set-A-05.png, region 4, and upper-left frame)
issues.what: A broad leaf fills the upper left and a long pendant blade cuts across the mid-left field. The target has a pointed upper overhang and a lower cluster of softly backlit angled leaves.
issues.fix: Pull the upper mass back into a pointed diagonal overhang, replace the hanging mid-left shape with a lower tier of layered leaves and stems, and recover the soft warm glints.

issues.where: 50.5 s, field behind the flower (set-A-06.png, region 6)
issues.what: Many forward-facing yellow rings of similar brightness and shape make a busy, continuous band behind the hero. The target has fewer distinct, softer and more varied blooms among larger dark foliage and stem shapes.
issues.fix: Break up and thin the band of bright faces, mix angles and sizes, increase blur on distant faces, and recover the target's darker green layering and selective warm highlights.

issues.what: The head reads more frontal and splayed; the disk is rounder and coarser with less visible fine green spiral structure, the left petals go pale yellow under harder shadows, and the right and lower petals flare farther outward rather than folding around the disk.
issues.fix: Angle the head slightly, make the disk less circular and restore the finer green seed spiral, tighten the right and lower petal curl and overlap, and make the transmitted light more amber with softer shading.

issues.where: 45.0 s, main stem and hairs (set-A-02.png, region 2)
issues.what: The stem reads as a rigid longitudinally ribbed column with thin bright rails, and the obvious upper branch fork is missing at the target height. The target shows individually resolved fine gold-white hairs and a softer dark-green core.
issues.fix: Match the stem's profile and upper fork height, tone down the parallel ribs and bright rails, and render fine independently resolved hairs along the stem and branch rims.

issues.where: 50.5 s, main stem and hairs (set-A-05.png, region 2)
issues.what: The ribbed shaft is left of the target and reads as two bright outlines with a soft hairy fringe on the branch. The target has a wider, softer green shaft, a more legible fork and a dense fringe of discrete fine hairs.
issues.fix: Move the shaft and fork slightly right, soften the ribs and continuous outlines, and separate the backlit hairs without whitening the core.

issues.what: The high right and lower left leaves that expose broad veined surfaces are replaced by lower, darker hanging or edge-on shapes. The target's bright translucent patches and fine curled, damaged margins are missing in those locations.
issues.fix: Restore the higher arch on the right and the broad lower-left leaf, turn their faces toward camera and bring back vein structure, selective translucency and curled margins.

issues.what: The right blade hangs farther down and the left blade is nearly edge-on, making both read as dark silhouettes rather than the target's front-facing veined leaves with green translucency and irregular tips.
issues.fix: Bring the right blade and curl upward, open the left blade toward camera, and restore green transmitted light, visible veins and irregular edge detail.

issues.where: 45.0 s, field behind the bud (set-A-03.png, region 6)
issues.what: The field is a more uniform olive-brown texture with floating yellow pinpoints. The target has soft but legible larger heads and glints nearer camera, cooler green shadow masses and a hazier transition toward the ridge.
issues.fix: Restore varied foreground-to-distance blur, larger soft sunflower silhouettes and selective stem glints, cool the dark foliage toward green, and layer in haze toward the horizon.

issues.where: 45.0 s, distant ridge and tree line (set-A-03.png, region 7)
issues.what: The ridge rides higher and reads as a flatter, near-black cutout; the target has a lower, softer, irregular blue-green skyline and more air between it and the field.
issues.fix: Lower and soften the ridge, vary its outline and lift the distant blacks into cool green-gray with gentle atmospheric separation.

issues.where: 50.5 s, distant ridge and tree line (set-A-06.png, region 7)
issues.what: The higher, uniform dark silhouette creates a hard stripe against the bright sky and yellow field, instead of the target's softened variable tree line.
issues.fix: Lower the ridge toward the target, soften its outline, vary its height and opacity, and use cooler lifted blacks to recover distance.

issues.where: 45.0 s, upper and right sky (set-A-03.png, region 8)
issues.what: A smooth brown-to-teal wash and isolated dark cloud islands leave a sharply segmented bright lower strip. The target has a more textured, continuous storm ceiling and warmer, more gradual light spread from the left. Bright circular motes are also more conspicuous.
issues.fix: Build broader textured cloud bands, soften and integrate their lower edge, recover the broad warm light gradient and shrink or dim the largest bright motes.

issues.where: 50.5 s, upper and right sky (set-A-06.png, region 8)
issues.what: The blue cloud shelf has prominent discrete dark lobes over a pale gap and the upper left has conspicuous round specks. The target's canopy is smoother in silhouette but more modulated internally, with warmer diffuse light on the left and subtler specks.
issues.fix: Merge the lower cloud lobes into a continuous softened band, add subtle tonal modulation, extend warm light from the left and dim or shrink the large specks.
